title: Restore page/relation predicate-lock caps to defaults to cut SIRead promotion churn
configuration_cause: Incumbent sets max_pred_locks_per_page=0 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=0, forcing immediate promotion of every page/relation SIRead lock to coarser granularity; this maximizes promotion churn and lock bookkeeping per GetUserTweets transaction (87.6% of terminal capacity).
mechanism: With max_pred_locks_per_page=0 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=0, PostgreSQL promotes SIRead locks to the coarsest granularity immediately, generating extra lock-manager work and lock-table churn on every GetUserTweets scan. Restoring the PostgreSQL defaults (page=2, relation=-2) keeps fine-grained SIRead locks longer, reducing promotion events and lock bookkeeping per transaction. Because GetUserTweets consumes 87.6% of finite terminal time, any per-transaction lock overhead reduction directly frees terminal capacity for more successful transactions. This is a distinct direction from the previously refuted 2->8/2->32 raises and the untested 0 extreme; it tests the default midpoint of the granularity axis.
query_effect: GetUserTweets index scans retain fine-grained SIRead locks instead of immediate promotion, reducing lock-manager work per call.
expected_tps_effect: Small increase (>=0.3%) if promotion churn is a real per-transaction cost; unchanged if lock bookkeeping is not on the critical path.
expected_latency_effect: GetUserTweets p99 should decrease slightly; p50 unchanged.

predictions.rationale: Restoring default caps keeps fine-grained SIRead locks longer, reducing promotion events and total lock count.
Less lock-manager work per GetUserTweets call lowers tail latency.
Freed terminal capacity from reduced per-transaction lock overhead raises successful TPS.

alternatives.statement: If lock bookkeeping is not on the critical path, locks_total.p95 may not decrease and TPS stays flat; the mechanism is then refuted and the granularity axis is exhausted.
If WAL sync latency dominates, restoring predicate-lock defaults will not move TPS; wal_timing.sync_average_ms would remain the binding constraint.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent sits at the coarsest SIRead extreme (0/0), which maximizes promotion churn. Restoring defaults tests the opposite direction on the same axis with a bounded, low-risk amplitude, and directly targets the 87.6% terminal-capacity transaction.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: PostgreSQL default 2, within safe [0,256]; reverses incumbent 0 extreme toward default midpoint.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: page-level predicate-lock granularity cap; higher value delays promotion to coarser granularity

knob_changes.numerical_basis: PostgreSQL default -2, within safe [-2,4096]; reverses incumbent 0 extreme toward default.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: relation-level predicate-lock granularity cap; -2 uses default fraction of per-txn budget

nodes.label: Default SIRead granularity reduces promotion churn and lock bookkeeping per GetUserTweets
